question: Which hero was the fastest?
evidence: which hero refers to superhero_name; fastest refers to MAX(attribute_value) WHERE attribute_name = 'Speed';
clarification: If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
gold: SELECT c0 FROM (SELECT T1.superhero_name AS c0, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY T2.attribute_value DESC) AS __r FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2.attribute_id = T3.id WHERE T3.attribute_name = 'Speed') AS __t WHERE __r <= 1
gold0: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2.attribute_id = T3.id WHERE T3.attribute_name = 'Speed' ORDER BY T2.attribute_value DESC LIMIT 1

d.request: Which superhero has the highest Speed attribute value (the fastest), and if multiple superheroes tie for that maximum Speed value, return all of them?
d.sql: SELECT s.superhero_name FROM superhero s JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND ha.attribute_value = (SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute ha2 JOIN attribute a2 ON ha2.attribute_id = a2.id WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Speed')
